This policy governs the retention period for customer account records maintained by the organization.

This policy is reviewed periodically by the governance committee to ensure continued alignment with applicable regulatory requirements.

Data Retention Policy — Customer Records > Scope

This policy applies to all customer-facing business units and any third-party data processors acting on the organization's behalf.
